policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance requires Norwegian citizens to obtain Iraq's eVisa before entry.
conditions: Obtain Iraq's electronic visa before travel using the ordinary Norwegian passport intended for entry. The Norwegian guidance separately notes that the Kurdistan Region has its own pre-travel electronic visa route.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Iraq eVisa service
steps: Apply before travel using the ordinary Norwegian passport to be used for entry.
Carry the issued eVisa information and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Norway establishes that Norwegian visitors need a Cuban visa, while Cuba's official tourism guidance says the internet tourist visa replaces the Tourist Card.
conditions: A Norwegian citizen needs a Cuban visa. Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel through the official Cuban route; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is a separate arrival form.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Norwegian passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance expressly grants these Norwegian-passport short-visitor visa exemptions.
conditions: BA, XK, TN and UA: up to 90 days on the respective Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance; XK uses a six-month reference period and UA a 180-day reference period. PA is visa-free for Norwegian citizens visiting Panama, with ordinary tourist stays stated as up to 90 days.

TN is expressly for tourism. UA has severe security and operational risks, including martial-law conditions, which do not change the recorded short-visitor visa status. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Bangladesh and Cambodia visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance expressly identifies visitor visa-on-arrival routes for Norwegian citizens in Bangladesh and Cambodia.
conditions: BD: Norwegian citizens may apply for a 30-day visa on arrival. KH: a tourist may obtain a visa at arrival; the same guidance also offers a separate online route.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport process gives a preapproval online and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The online route is for a valid ordinary passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.

At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the ordinary Norwegian passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Côte d'Ivoire evisa, but the official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
The fallback's generic visa_required label is superseded by current Norwegian guidance expressly requiring Iraq's eVisa before entry.
